finalists.label: Acute Coronary Syndrome
finalists.why: It has the most specific for evidence, including ST segment depression and thrombotic occlusion of saphenous vein graft.

finalists.label: Myocardial Infarction
finalists.why: It has strong for evidence, including ST segment depression and thrombotic occlusion of saphenous vein graft, and is a more general diagnosis than Acute Coronary Syndrome.

finalists.label: Graft Occlusion
finalists.why: It is a specific diagnosis that explains the thrombotic occlusion of saphenous vein graft found in the vignette.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it has the most specific for evidence, including ST segment depression and thrombotic occlusion of saphenous vein graft, which are decisive findings in the vignette.
